# The dashboard number isn't your payout. Take-home is.

> Free calculator for Twitch streamers: find real monthly take-home from Tier 1/2/3 subs (50% default, or 60%/70% under the Plus Program) and Bits, see whether a mobile subscription really pays less (it doesn't), and check how many more subs close a monthly income gap.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
